steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: The TV station's in total chaos...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Grandma told me stories about Northern Court special forces infiltrating Mitsukue in her youth.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I didn't think much of it at the time. Thinking about it now, though, what we're seeing is just a fraction of what could really happen...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: What do you think about my surprise for Kinbee?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I think it might be a little too big...

spans.text: I think it might be a little

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Well, we should focus on our own tasks. Moriuchi-san has already infiltrated the TV station. We need to head to the accession ceremony.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: There shouldn't be many people there at this time, but you'll need to help out if there's any resistance.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: All that's left to do is act! I'll lead the way. Climb up this vent!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Follow me!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I-I'm coming!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It... it's so high...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Don't worry, I've got a light. Hold my hand, and I'll lead you on.
Momoka tries not to look down, but she cannot keep herself from shaking.
They are moving through massive formations of steel rebar. The darkness of night hangs above, while it is bright as day underneath their feet.
TV station staff, yakuza, and ninja form a picture of chaos beneath them.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: How are you doing, Kichisei?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: You don't come up to this kind of place often?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Who does? Are you a deserting ninja or something?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: No, I got used to this kind of place while hiding from ninjas.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hiding?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: That's not important—we're here!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Hmph, we've got people down below...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Momoka, jump over this gap and follow those pipes down to the stage. You should be able to stay out of their view.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: That far?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I, I'll try...
Momoka clenches her fists, her eyes fixed forward, and kicks the ground hard—
The steel structure suddenly starts moving, and the platform beneath Momoka's feet begins to vibrate irregularly.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Why did it start moving all of a sudden?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I, I think I'm falling!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Watch your head!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: She fell?!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: We're going down too! Sarasa!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Ya—hoo!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Are you alright, Momoka?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm alright! Hanging in there.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Get on the stage! I'll get the console! Start once the lights come on!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: I can't wait for Momoka's show—

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't let you do that.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mio-san...?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: ...Momoka.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You've come to stop me, haven't you?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: For the Kinsekikai.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I know what you're going to say. That will ruin the Kinsekikai.

steps.name: Surveilling Ninja
steps.text: Mio-san, Hoshiguma has shown up at the door of the TV station. You should go now, according to Mifune-san's instructions—

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Hoshiguma showed up for her.

steps.name: Surveilling Ninja
steps.text: But Mifune-san—

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: The other one watching me, I know you're there. Go and tell Mifune-san that Hoshiguma will definitely come, and I'll be waiting for her here.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Now, Momoka, Kichisei-san, and that girl hiding behind the console, whose name I do not know.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I suggest you stay put until Hoshiguma shows up.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Your grievances against Mifune-san and Kinsekikai are certainly legitimate. But this place is also home to me, and to many others.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I can't let you destroy it.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: She's bluffing! Momoka—
The black ethereal hand suddenly appears in front of Kichisei's neck. She instinctively takes a step back and pulls the trigger.
The ethereal hand shreds the bead-shaped grenade.
The lights go out, and the stage darkens, illuminated only by a faint light in the direction of the console.
Mio walks towards the light, sword in one hand, tantou in the other.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: That's right, I'm here... come on now...
One of the spotlights suddenly turns on, shining straight into Mio's eyes. Then another, and another, and another—
Then they all turn off at the same time.
Mio's hesitation lasts only an instant. She takes a moment to collect herself, then charges at the console—
Bang!
A falling spotlight narrowly misses Mio's head. By the time she turns her gaze back to the control console, there is no longer anyone there.
While Mio is occupied with the console, Kichisei, Momoka and Sarasa begin running towards the side stage exit.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: She locked the door! Let's try another—
Click, click, click.
They hear the sounds of locks being engaged...
The lights above their head turn back on.
Mio slowly walks towards the gathered trio.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: The lights are no longer under your control. Resistance is futile.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: You think so?
Sarasa closes her eyes and raises her lamp-shaped staff.
Mio's pace quickens.
Suddenly, the tip of the staff emits a blinding light, and the spotlights above the stage turn off again.
Not just the spotlights. All the light that remains on the stage is trapped in the liquid bouncing at the tip of the staff—

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Lights out, ice queen!
—and even the last glimmer of light is utterly consumed.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Sarasa?!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Let... me sleep... I'm... so tired...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: (Whisper) Wh-What do we do? I can hear Mio-san's footsteps! She's coming!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: (Whisper) Let's try the other side of the stage. Maybe the door there's still unlocked...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Whisper) No, it's too far. She'll find us!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Whisper) This is where we fell, isn't it? Can we go back the way we came?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: (Whisper) The vents—
Kichisei puts Sarasa on her back and was about to move, when they hear Mio's voice coming from center stage.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Don't bother. I can hear you.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What do we do?!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: It's all or nothing. I'll deal with her—
Suddenly, she hears the sound of knocking behind her.
Is it locked? I guess we'll have to do this the hard way.
Get out of the way!
A massive crash, and the locked door swings open, bringing in light from beyond.
The next instant, as though answering the call of the light coming in from the door, bright orbs of light float up from Sarasa's staff and go back to where they came from—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Sarasa?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: I thought I would get to sleep for a little longer...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: There'll be no light here as long as I'm still asleep...
Sarasa yawns, and the spotlights above flicker.
Mio does not move from her position, so Sarasa begins walking towards the console.
Momoka follows hesitantly, but Mio remains in place.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Aren't you going to stop them?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No. Your blade is drawn.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: My duty is not to deal with them.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I doubt your minions have what it takes to beat Kichisei and Sarasa.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: In that case, there's nothing I can do.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What about Mifune?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I don't care.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Our battle has nothing to do with him.

steps.name: Police Operator
steps.text: The last TV station's back online, Detective Koretou!

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: I hear you.

steps.name: Police Operator
steps.text: The guys assigned to the fireworks show want to know what to do. The citizens are still uneasy after that scare.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Any risk of a stampede or other serious accident?

steps.name: Police Operator
steps.text: Minimal. The situation's very much within expected parameters.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Then the show will go on. Mifune likes excitement. We'll give him excitement.

steps.name: Police Operator
steps.text: We're getting calls from citizens asking what happened. What do you think...?

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: What do you think I think? Tell them we're investigating.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Kinseki Station is, of course, responsible for the erroneous announcement of a Northern Court invasion, and we're taking this very seriously—

steps.name: Officer on Patrol
steps.text: Detective Koretou, you have a visitor!

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Who? Kouhei Mifune?

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Detective Koretou.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: If it wasn't Mifune, I thought it would have been his Diet friend paying a personal visit.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Making insinuations will do no favors for your career. Besides, you overestimate your own importance.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Should I take that as an admission?

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: I've come to warn you.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: The police must bear responsibility for the chaos that occurred on Nita Street tonight. We do not wish to see the chaos spread any further.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Bear responsibility, eh? Oh dear, I think I just peed my pants.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Watch your attitude. You still have a chance to settle this matter peacefully.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Do I? Pray enlighten me.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Cancel all events scheduled for tonight. Focus your forces on restoring order at Kinseki Station, and begin a search for those responsible.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Such as? The number one suspect is, I'm sure, Kouhei Mifune, considering that it was his station that broadcast that—

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Your men are not allowed to touch him—

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Have a nice day.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: If you refuse to obey orders, you may go once you have signed this resignation.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: Feel free to discuss any concerns with your supervisor.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Wow, I still have a chance to turn back?

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: It's too late for that.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Like you said, it's too late for that—
The detective reaches out with his foot...

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: You—
...He trips the visitor, takes the piece of paper with the name of the detective's supervisor on it, and tears it to pieces.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Oh my, I didn't expect you to fall like that. I thought our diet friend would have a tougher secretary.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: How... how dare you?!

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Go tell your boss that the police are here to protect his bloody life, not his bloody money.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: If he really thinks someone's after his life, he can come personally to the station and file a report, and we'll take it into consideration.

steps.name: Detective Koretou
steps.text: Now, get lost.
White sword, black gloves, white hand, black sword, white tantou, black ethereal hand—

It is a dizzying exchange of black and white. Contrary to the impression she gives, the Liberi's swordplay is overwhelmingly aggressive, with only attacks, feints and more attacks, with not the slightest attention paid to defense.
The moves of the one-horned Oni, on the other hand, are almost staggeringly basic. Dodge, parry, backstep, sidestep.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Twelve.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You just blocked twelve attacks in quick succession.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Why don't you fight back? Are you still afraid of your sword?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If I was, it wouldn't have left its sheath to begin with.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You, on the other hand, look all polite and cultured, but your moves are pure aggression and ferocity. That's not Kinbee's style.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: My sword has nothing to do with him.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Then why do you give your life for him?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Since when have I given my life for him?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Stop fooling yourself.
Hoshiguma takes a deliberate look around.
Kichisei is sending explosions everywhere with her grenades, while the stage equipment has turned into a giant monster under Sarasa's control.
With Momoka doing an impressive job of not getting caught, the trio is more than holding their own.
There is only one last thing to do in their battle plan...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: The only thing I'm trying to protect is the Kinsekikai.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And Kinbee has to lead it?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: The Kinsekikai needs to be a place where the dregs of society can survive, those who have nowhere else to go.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And Tessai couldn't give you that?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You can keep parrying—

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: But you'll eventually show an opening.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Finally, you're attacking.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: All I got was the edge of your clothes.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: There is blue fire burning around you. Is that your Arts?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Blue fire?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're right. I didn't notice.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Back to the question. What is it that Tessai couldn't give you, but Kinbee can?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Tessai could not even protect himself—
Hoshiguma thrusts. The attack is simple, but the flames upon the sword force Mio to leap backwards.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's not what I wanted to hear.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Your flames are burning even fiercer.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Tell me. Why couldn't Tessai give you what you wanted?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Because Tessai couldn't protect himself. Mitsukue didn't need him, nor did it need a Mio working under Tessai.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: A silent, ragged orphan who only fights tooth and nail when someone steps on her is a subject of scorn.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: An equally silent, well-dressed assistant who only draws her sword when the company's interests are compromised is the subject of admiration.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I thought you came from some noble martial family fallen on hard times.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Tessai wanted to give dregs of society like us a home, and so he's dead.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mifune knows we don't deserve a home, and so he lives on.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Is that how Mitsukue judges the Kinsekikai?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Always has.
Hoshiguma is almost completely engulfed in the azure flame.
The Liberi wonders if the flame will consume the Oni before it consumes her.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You are angry.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Were you angry like this too, twenty years ago?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Does that matter?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mifune-san wants you to lose your reason, as you did twenty years ago. He believes it will turn you into a crazed beast, one that everyone will be eager to put down.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You know this is what he wants, and so you suppress yourself, which is why you didn't draw your sword the last time.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are you inviting me to give in to anger? Complete the mission your master assigned?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It's not what I want, but I would have no issue with it. It would be a shame, that's all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: A perfect opponent, who could never stand before me in perfect condition, forced to either suppress herself, or lose control entirely.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: But that's all.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Take this.
Mio once again prepares to attack.
Three hands, three swords, a posture seemingly without form or order, but ready to pounce on any weakness—
Catch!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: This is crazy heavy!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You know how hard it was to get it out of Kinbee's room, even with all that chaos at the TV station?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: ...Catch!
Moriuchi swings his entire body to throw Hannya in the direction of the standoff.

Mio's ethereal hand is the first to catch Hannya's handle, but Hoshiguma leaps and spins one hundred and eighty degrees like she is dancing, forcing the ethereal hand to loosen its grip, allowing her to take Hannya's handle.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Suppress, or lose control?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It won't happen. With or without Hannya.
Hoshiguma tightens her grip around the ribbon on her sword.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hannya's an old friend, after all. Maybe you had a chance just now... but not any longer.
Rage.
The rage that seemed compressed around Hoshiguma now spreads outwards, burning on her arms, her shield, and her sword.
Hoshiguma takes a step forward, and the flames of rage almost catch the hem of Mio's clothing.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: It's good enough for me to know that you won't lose control.
Hoshiguma faces off against black and white, hands human and not, swords long and short.
The Liberi shows no fear. The edges of her mouth angle ever so slightly upwards.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Any last words?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Be kind to the Kinsekikai.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Be kind to Momoka.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: My conscience is clear on all other matters... except her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll remember.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What about Kinbee? Any last words about him you want to say?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Him? Is there any need to talk about him, here and now?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah. Good point.
Hoshiguma shifts her posture to one that makes it easy to unleash her power. The blue flames continue to burn intermittently around her.
The face of Hannya glares with wide-open eyes on the face of the shield. The edge of the sword seems ready to seep blue blood—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Is this... Hannya?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yes, this is Hannya.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Your swords are worthy of you. They took the full brunt of Hannya and survived.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You can pick them up, then we'll continue.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: There's no need.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You've made your strength clear. There's no point in trying to fight you anymore.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I must prepare.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: For what?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: For the aftermath.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: For a Kinsekikai without Mifune-san.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How's things on Momoka's side, Moriuchi? Are they ready?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Just waiting for you to finish fighting. Sarasa?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Aye aye, sir! Momoka?
Momoka stands in the middle of the stage with the spotlight on her.
Kichisei has done her best to clear a space, though there are still a few yakuza lying on the ground near her.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I... I'm ready to begin!

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Alright then...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Kinseki Station's biggest program of the night begins now!
